selection.rule: Dependency-complete first 24 questions from the question-sheet selection order.

questions.question: How did the sinful group react to the signs that point to Allah’s oneness?
questions.answer: They rejected them and chose disbelief.

questions.question: How did they treat the creatures of the world in their false view?
questions.answer: They looked down on them and dishonored them.

questions.question: What did they reject that made their guilt even greater?
questions.answer: The manifestations of the divine names.

questions.question: What did they become deserving of because of this?
questions.answer: Endless punishment.

questions.question: Why does the passage mention delicate senses and well-made body systems?
questions.answer: To show they were created with wise and high purposes.

questions.question: What is the first great purpose of human abilities?
questions.answer: To recognize the many blessings from Allah.

questions.question: What is the first main purpose of the human faculties?
questions.answer: To help a person recognize Allah’s blessings and thank and worship Him.

questions.question: How does experience help a person according to the passage?
questions.answer: It helps the person know these signs and believe in them.

questions.question: What two outcomes come from fulfilling both purposes?
questions.answer: Human growth and true human completion.

questions.question: When the wrongdoers reached the age of understanding, what path did they choose?
questions.answer: They chose unbelief and wrongdoing.

questions.question: What should they have done with blessings, and what did they do instead?
questions.answer: They should have been thankful, but instead they were ungrateful.

questions.question: What was their attitude toward the beings around them?
questions.answer: They acted as if those beings had no worth.

questions.question: What does the passage say about the result of denying these truths?
questions.answer: It says they committed a huge crime and deserved never-ending punishment.

questions.question: According to the passage, what was the purpose of the “capital” of life?
questions.answer: It was meant for carrying out human duties.

questions.question: What question is raised about civilization and bodily pleasure?
questions.answer: Whether these can really be the whole duty of life.

questions.question: What does the first purpose teach a person to notice?
questions.answer: The many gifts of the True Giver.

questions.question: What acts are linked to that first aim?
questions.answer: Thankfulness and worship.

questions.question: What role does experience have in the second aim?
questions.answer: It helps a person recognize those manifestations in a real way.

questions.question: Which two bad responses are mentioned first about the sinful group?
questions.answer: Disbelief toward the signs and ingratitude toward blessings.

questions.question: Why is their crime described as extremely great?
questions.answer: Because they denied many signs of Allah and rejected His names in a short life.

questions.question: What is the other main reason humans were given these abilities?
questions.answer: So they can notice and experience the signs of Allah’s names in creation.

questions.question: What is the first of the two main aims in human creation?
questions.answer: To know Allah’s gifts and respond with thanks.

questions.question: Name the other main aim of creating these faculties.
questions.answer: The other aim is to let people know the manifestations of Allah’s names and believe through that knowledge.

questions.question: What is the second great purpose of human abilities?
questions.answer: To perceive how Allah’s names appear in the world.

title: Warning to the Wicked and the Self Misuse of Human Faculties and Their Two Main Purposes
